        .split_whitespace()
        .map(|s| match s {
            "zero" => 0,
            "one" => 1,
            "two" => 2,
            "three" => 3,
            "four" => 4,
            "five" => 5,
            "six" => 6,
            "seven" => 7,
            "eight" => 8,
            "nine" => 9,
            _ => panic!("Invalid number word: {}", s),
        })
        .collect();
    nums.sort();
    let words = ["zero", "one", "two", "three", "four", "five", "six", "seven", "eight", "nine"];
    let result: String = nums
        .iter()
        .map(|&n| words[n as usize])
        .collect::<Vec<_>>()
        .join(" ");
    result
